annotations.title: Threads data: search and account posts

description: One node for Threads: search public posts for a keyword or hashtag, or get an account's latest posts. Pick an action; each has its own price. Use it when: A task needs Threads: what people say about a topic, or what a brand or creator posted and how it landed. Not for: Private accounts, follower lists or messages. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 20 s. Actions: search (search public posts for a keyword or hashtag; needs query); posts (an account's latest 10 posts; needs handle). Price: from $0.062 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: posts $0.062, search $0.062 (default search). One call = one Threads action (search or an account's posts).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. search (needs query), posts (needs handle). Default search

handle.description: Threads username without @, e.g. natgeo (for: posts)

query.description: Keyword or hashtag to search, e.g. AI agents (for: search)

sort.description: top (most relevant) or recent (newest first). Default top (for: search)
